description: How each demo and gallery example fares against the UI SDK flavour, as a project that installed the flavour sees it. Generated by `node scripts/check-ui-sdk-compat.mjs --write`; `pnpm check:ui-sdk-compat` fails when it is stale.

statuses.ok: its flavour source is the original; it typechecks, no recorded behaviour difference

statuses.variant: its flavour source is the overlay at packages/registry/registry/ui-sdk/examples/<path>; `replaces` lists what the original hits in the flavour, `reasons` any difference the variant keeps
